svg.font-family: Geist, Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Smart HRMS
svg.text: An HR platform with role-based access for employees, evaluators, HR, and PMT officers,
backed by four Python modules: rule-based leave and IPCR routing, a linear-regression
performance predictor, a real-time attendance analytics dashboard, and a training
recommender. Ships as a desktop app through Electron.
Laravel 12 · React 19 · Inertia.js · MySQL · Python · Electron · Pest
